title: DAVID: a web server for functional annotation and functional enrichment analysis of gene lists (2025 update).

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Fetched the DAVID homepage and its Knowledgebase download page; the bulk data is behind a 'Request data from the DAVID Knowledgebase' link to /knowledgebase/login.html. The old direct zip URL returns 404. Europe PMC full text returned HTTP 500 and the supplement endpoint returned no zip; no accessions found.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything about the update (DAVID Ortholog, Gene Search, REST APIs, Neo4j backend) comes from the abstract only.

a1_downloadable.note: Checked the download page: bulk Knowledgebase download needs a login/request form; old direct zip link is 404. Only the interactive web server and API are open.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: This is a software/web-server paper; there is no measured outcome column. Any label (e.g. gene annotation terms) would have to be constructed from aggregated third-party databases.

a3_inputs_present.note: Not checked in files; the Knowledgebase is identifier-to-annotation pairs, no sequences, per the download page description.

a4_units_stated.note: Not applicable: annotation pairs, no measured quantities.

a5_enough_rows.note: No row count verified; files not accessible.

a8_label_provenance.note: Annotations are re-aggregated from Gene Ontology (GO), KEGG, UniProt and others, some of which are themselves computationally inferred; better to use those primary sources directly.

honest_claim_h3: None: the paper describes a web tool, not a dataset with a measured outcome.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use a gene's identity or sequence to predict which functional categories it belongs to.
plain_idea.train_on: Gene identifiers paired with annotation terms from the DAVID Knowledgebase; number of examples unknown because the bulk files need a login request.
plain_idea.predict: Functional annotation terms (e.g. Gene Ontology categories), which DAVID copies from other curated or computed databases rather than measuring.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Weak: gene-function prediction is already done directly from Gene Ontology and UniProt, so DAVID adds nothing as a training source.

ml_idea: None viable; gene function prediction should use GO/UniProt directly (e.g. CAFA benchmark), not DAVID.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Open the Knowledgebase download page: bulk data requires a login request (done, fails).

verdict_reason: Web-server software update with no measured label; the bulk Knowledgebase download requires a login request (A1 fail) and annotations are re-aggregated from other databases (A2/A8 fail).
